_comment: Example configuration for the Science Spread Tracer (Elgora bounty #9). Copy to config.json and edit: papers, window and enabled channels. The tracker derives every dataset row from evidence/ files using this configuration; removing a paper removes its rows, disabling a channel removes that channel's rows. No secrets are stored here.

api_credentials_required.bluesky: none in principle - public Bluesky API (public.api.bsky.app), no auth for searchPosts. NOTE: from this VM the endpoint is 403-blocked at the egress CDN, so the tracker's Bluesky fetcher cannot run here; Bluesky rows in this submission were found by web search and saved as single-post page extracts (same replay path).
api_credentials_required.hackernews: none - public Algolia HN search API (hn.algolia.com)
api_credentials_required.mastodon: none for reading public post pages; instance search APIs need a token, so discovery is via web search
api_credentials_required.news_blogs: none - web search plus direct page fetch; some sites may block bots
api_credentials_required.reddit: none in principle - public old.reddit.com / reddit.com search JSON. NOTE: from this VM both return 403, so the tracker's Reddit fetcher cannot run here; Reddit rows in this submission were found by web search and saved as single-post page extracts (same replay path).
api_credentials_required.x: none usable - X post pages are login-walled; no verified X rows could be collected from this environment
api_credentials_required.youtube: none for reading public video pages; no API key used (title/description scraped from page HTML, may be blocked)

papers.title: In Vivo CRISPR Base Editing of ANGPTL3 for Durable Lipid Lowering
An AI-native experimental laboratory for autonomous biomolecular operations
Observation of prethermal dynamical phase transitions and resonant melting
Hydrogen Derivatives Enable Cost-Effective Carbon Neutrality in China
Ecological and social cues orchestrate concerted courtship in Drosophila
In vivo CAR-T double knockout screen maps synergistic antitumour gene pairs
A two-dimensional reticular triaxial molecularly woven fabric
Accelerating commercialization and deployment of indoor photovoltaics
The true scale of global wildlife trade is obscured by data gaps

rate_limits.bluesky: public.api.bsky.app searchPosts is unauthenticated; the collector sleeps 0.5s between queries
rate_limits.hackernews: Algolia HN API is unauthenticated and generous; the collector sleeps 0.5s between queries
rate_limits.news_blogs: no bulk API; one page fetch per candidate URL
rate_limits.reddit: reddit search JSON is unauthenticated but frequently 429s; the collector retries twice then skips
rate_limits.wikipedia: MediaWiki API: max 50 revisions per call, 0.5s between calls, descriptive User-Agent required
